content: Akasɩ́pʋ́ Dúanyɔ Ámʋ Sumbíwa
Yesu lɛ́tɩ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ fia, ɔlɛha amʋ́ túmi, há amʋ́ ɔkpa ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋgyáa ɔŋɛ laláhɛ fɛ́ɛ́, abʋtsa ɩlɔ.
Ɔlɔwa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɛ́da Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɔkan, abʋtsa alɔpʋ.
Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlɔyɔ́ á, mlɩmátsu tɔtɔ. Mlɩmátsu oyi yiáhɛ́, akpankogyo, atogyihɛ, kɔ́ba ntɛ́ɛ atadɩɛ nyɔɔsɩ.
Wóyígyíwóyítɔ́á bɔ́hɔ mlɩ á, mlɩtsia ɩnʋ yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá mlɛ́dalɩ wúlu amʋtɔ.
Nɩ́ bʋmɔhɔ mlɩ wúlu kʋsʋ, mlɩdɛ́dalɩ mlɔyɔ́ á, mlɩkpakpa mlɩ ayabitɔ-ɩsɩ wʋlɩ wúlu amʋtɔ, isuna ánɩ́ bʋmɛbɩ bwɛ́.”
Bɛnatɩ́ kí nsɩnɛ́ ɩnʋ awúlu fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́, bʋdɛ asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan da, tsá ɩlɔ.
Herode Légyigyáa
Brɛ́á Galilea ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ Herode lónu tɔ́á ɩdɛ mʋ́sʋ́ yɔ á, olegyigyáa. Tsúfɛ́ akʋ bʋdɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane lakʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, “Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ dada Elia lálɛ́ ɩwɩ ɔwan.” Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, “Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ dada amʋtɔ ɔkʋ lákʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Herode lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nahá batɩn Yohane. Ngya oyin ɔmɔmʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ntráa ndenu alɩ?” Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔbɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ ánɩ́ mówun Yesu.
Ahá Mpɩ́m-nu Atogyihɛ Ha
Yesu sumbí ayɔpʋ́ amʋ beyinkí bá bɛbláa mʋ tɔ́á bayɔ́bwɛ. Ɔlɛkpa amʋ́ buo ɩwɩ, amʋ́ nkʋlɛ bɔyɔ Betsaida wúlutɔ.
Brɛ́á ɔdɔm amʋ bɛbɩ ánɩ́ ɔbʋ ɩnʋ á, begya mʋ ɔkpa yɔ́ ɩnʋ. Yesu lɔ́hɔ amʋ́ atúu, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ Bulu iwíegyí amʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n, ɔlɛtsa amʋ́á bʋdɛlɔ.

Brɛ́á owí dɛpɔ́ɔn a, sumbí ayɔpʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ bɛba bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, “Ha amʋ́ abʋnatɩ, mɛ́nɩ bɛ́talɩ́ yɔ́ awúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ mantáa nfɩsʋ yódunká atogyihɛ mʋ́a ɔdɩkpa, tsúfɛ́ anɩméenya tɔtɔ há amʋ́ dimbí ánfɩtɔ.”

Támɛ Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩdunka atɔ́ ha amʋ́ abʋgyi.” Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Tɔ́á anɩbʋ fɛ́ɛ́ gyí bodobodo apin anu pʋ́ ntsutso iye bwáhɛ́ anyɔ. Nkɛ́tɩ anɩlayɔ́hɔ atogyihɛ ba ahá ánfɩ fɛ́ɛ́.”
(Ayin ánɩ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ bɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ mpɩ́m-nu (5,000).) Yesu lɛ́bláa akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩha amʋ́ abʋtsia okútɔ́. Iku kʋlɛ ɩbwɛ́ɛ fɛ́ ahá aduenu (50).”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔbwɛ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́, ɔhagyíɔha létsiá asɩ.

Ɩnʋ olotsu bodobodo anu pʋ́ ntsutso iye bwáhɛ́ anyɔ ámʋ. Ɩnʋ olotsu ansɩ́ fʋ́á kɩ́ɩ ɔsʋ́sʋ́, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán. Mʋ́ʋ́ olebiabía mʋ́tɔ́ pʋ́há akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyée mʋ́ ha ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ abʋgyi.
Amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ begyi mwɛ sian. Brɛ́á akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔtɔsɩ́ isíanhɛ amʋ a, ɩlɔbʋlá alakpá dúanyɔ.
Ɔhá Ánɩ́ Yesu Gyí
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Yesu nkʋlɛ dɛ́ mpáɩ bɔ, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ma ahá bɛɛ ngyi?”
Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Akʋ bɛɛ, fʋ́gyí Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane. Akʋ bɛɛ, Bulu Ɔnɔ́sʋ́ Ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Elia. Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ dada ɔkʋ lákʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ ɛ́ mɛ́? Mlɩa mɩ́gyí ma?” Petro lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) nɩ.”
Yesu Ɩwɩɔsɩn Pʋ́ Mʋ Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́da amʋ́ ɔlá kpákpáákpá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋmábláa ɔhaa mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ánfɩ.

Ɔlɛtrá bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ilehián ánɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛ́hɩɛ wun ɩwɩɔsɩn tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ Yudafɔ ahandɛ, Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ; amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ békiná mɩ́, há bɔ́mɔ mɩ́, támɛ Bulu ɔbɛ́lakʋ́sʋ́a mɩ tsú afúlitɔ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa ahá ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ ɔkʋ dékléá obóbuo mɩ á, osíi tɔ́á otekle bwɛ, otsu mʋ oyikpalíhɛ ekekegyíɛkɛ bobuo mɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́prɩ mʋ nkpa á, ɔbɔ́hʋlɩ́ɩ mʋ́. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɛ́ lési mʋ nkpa há mɩ́ sʋ ɛ́ á, Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ mʋ nkpa.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ onyá ɔyɩ́tɔ́ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́, támɛ ɔhʋ́lɩ mʋ ɔkláa a, labi mɔmʋ ɩlɔwa há mʋ?
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ onyá mɩ́a mɩ́ atosunáhɛ́ pɛ́lɩ a, mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ nénya mʋ pɛ́lɩ brɛ́á nna mɩ́a mɩ́ Sɩ́ pʋ́ mʋ abɔpʋ wánkɩ́hɛ́ numnyamtɔ nɛbá.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Akʋ bʋbʋ mlɩtɔ nfɩ bʋmóowu asa bówun Bulu iwíegyí amʋ.”
Yesu Ɩwɩtsɛ́ɛ
Yesu lɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ ndawɔ́tswɩ́ ɔma a, ɔlɛkpa Petro mʋa Yohane pʋ́ Yakobo buo ɩwɩ, bɔdʋ yɔ́ mpáɩ ɔbɔkpá ɩbʋ kʋsʋ.
Brɛ́á ɔdɛ mpáɩ ámʋ bɔ á, mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́ lɛtsɛ. Mʋ atadɩɛ lofulí hʋ́nánáná, ɩdɛ ogyá kpa.
Ɩnʋ á, ahá abanyɔ́ ánɩ́ batsíá kɩ, bʋgyi Mose mʋa Elia bɛlɛ ɩwɩ ɔwan ɔsʋ́sʋ́ numnyamtɔ. Amʋ́a Yesu bɔtɔɩ́ tsú mʋ lowuá Bulu lɛ́hɩɛ tswɩ mʋ ánɩ́ ɩmɔ́ɔwa ɔpá obówu Yerusalem ɩwɩ.
Petro mʋa mʋ aba ámʋ bɛdɩdɩ. Brɛ́á bɔwan tsinkí á, bowun Yesu numnyam, ahá abanyɔ́ ámʋ ɛ́ bʋlɩɩ́ mʋ wá.
Brɛ́á ahá abanyɔ́ ámʋ bʋdɛnatɩ́ á, Petro lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, ɩbʋ alɛ́á abétsiá nfɩ. Ha ada abú asa. Fʋ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Mose klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Elia ɛ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ.” (Ɔmɛbɩ tɔ́á ɔdɛblɩ́).
Brɛ́á ɔdɛ asʋ́n ánfɩ blɩ́ á, agyinde kʋ lobobun amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́. Ɩnʋ ifu lɛkɩtá amʋ́ abasá ámʋ.
Ɩnʋ á, ɔmɛ kʋ lɛdalɩ tsu agyinde amʋtɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔ́nɩ gyí mɩ́ Bíá nalɛ́ nɩ́. Mlɩyaa asʋ amlɩnu mʋ ɔmɛ.”
Ɔmɛ amʋ lótsutsúa ɩbɛka tin á, ɩlasí Yesu nkʋlɛ ɩnʋ. Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛkpa ɔnɔ́ bun asʋ́n ánfɩsʋ nkɛ ámʋtɔ. Bʋmɛbláa ɔhaa ɩtɔ́á bayówun.
Ɩlɔ Dɩ́dahɛ Ɔlɔpʋ́ Tsa
Mʋ́ ɔyɩ kɛhɛ a, Yesu mʋa akasɩ́pʋ́ abasá ámʋ bɛkplɩ́ tsú ɩbʋ ámʋsʋ, ɔdɔm amʋ befia mʋ.
Ɩnʋ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋ lɔ́kplʋn ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, kókoli, damli kɩ mɩ́ bí ha mɩ. Obi yinhɛ́ ɔkʋlɛ pɛ́ ogyi mɩ́.
Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ kʋ towíé mʋtɔ, ɔtɔkplʋ́n. Ɔtɛdɩda gbla, ɔdɛkɔ tsikitsiki, mʋ ɔnɔ́ tɔbwɛ́ afu. Ipiantɔ asa itesí mʋ, ɩdɛ mʋ yintá.
Nobobwií ɩpa há fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ mbɛ́ɛ, bʋgyáa mʋ́ lɛ mʋtɔ, támɛ bʋmɛtalɩ́.”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛmba-abíá mlɩmá hógyi, mlɩ tsiátɔ́ ma alɛ. Alɩ́ nétsiá mlɩ wá, nyá klʋn há mlɩ ekekegyíɛkɛ nɩ́?” Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa oyin ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kpa fʋ́ bí ámʋ ba mɩ.”
Brɛ́á ɔlɛkpa kebi ámʋ ɔbá á, ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ lɛ́fɩn mʋ dá, ɔdɛkɔ tsikitsiki. Támɛ Yesu lɔ́kplʋn wa ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ, tsá kebi ámʋ. Ɩnʋ oleyinkía mʋ há mʋ sɩ.

Bulu túmi kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ lɛha ɔnɔ́ lobwie ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́. Yesu Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́ Otse Nyɔɔsɩ (Mateo 17:22-23; Marko 9:30-32) Brɛ́á mʋ bwɛhɛ́ ɩdɛ ɔhagyíɔha wánwan wa á, Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mlɩhɩɛ yaa asʋ amlɩnu. Bɛ́lɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ há adʋ́n bɔ́mɔ mɩ́.”
Támɛ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bomonu mʋ́ asɩ. Bulu lɔ́pʋ mʋ́ asɩnu ŋáín amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩmɔwankɩ́ amʋ́ asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔdɛblɩ́. Ifú ɛ́ dɛ amʋ́ ánɩ́ bɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ.
Ma Ɔbɔ́bwɛ Ɔhandɛ?
Nwɛ́ɛn kʋ lɛ́ba akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ nsɩnɛ́, tsú amʋ́tɔ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́bwɛ ɔhandɛ ɩwɩ.
Yesu lɛ́bɩ amʋ́ agywɩɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛkpa kebi ɔkʋ bɛlɩɩ́ mʋ ɩwɩ wá.

Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ kebi ánfɩ mɩ́ dátɔ́ lahɔ mɩ. Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔhɔ mɩ ɛ́ lahɔ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔwa mɩ́ ámʋ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ogyi ɔtráhɛ mlɩtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ gyí ɔdɛ́hɛn.”
Anɩ Obúopʋ
Yohane lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, anɩlówun oyin ɔkʋ dɛ́pʋ fʋ́ dá gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ, anɩlɛ́ka mʋ tin, tsúfɛ́ ɔma anɩtɔ.”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmáka mʋ tin! Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mlɩsʋ buo mlɩ.”
Samariafɔ Bʋmɔhɔ Yesu
Brɛ́á nkɛá Bulu obótsu Yesu ya ɔsʋ́sʋ́ dɛkpʋkpɛ́ ba a, ɔlɔbwɛ agywɩɩn ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́yɔ Yerusalem kokooko.
Ɔlɔwa abí gyankpá yɔ́ Samaria wúlu kʋsʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɛ́la ɩnʋ yaɩ ha mʋ.
Támɛ bʋmɔhɔ mʋ wúlu amʋtɔ, tsúfɛ́ Yerusalem ɔyɔ́.
Brɛ́á mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ Yakobo mʋa Yohane bowun alɩ á, bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíé, fʋdeklé fɛɛ ahá ogyá itsu ɔsʋ́sʋ́ bɔhɔ amʋ́ mɔ́?”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́damlí, wá ɩyɩn wá amʋ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ bɔpʋ ɔkpa yɔ́ wúlu bámbásʋ́ a.
Ahá Ánɩ́ Bɛɛ Bɔ́bwɛ Yesu Abúopʋ
Brɛ́á bʋna ɔkpatɔ bɔyɔ́ á, oyin ɔkʋ lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nóbuo fʋ yɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á fɔyɔ́.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa oyin ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Awɩá bʋbʋ mbɔ́, mbubwi ɛ́ bʋbʋ asia, támɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ mʋ́ á, mma ɔtɩ́nɛ́á nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ nwun tswɩ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa ɔha bambá ɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bobuo mɩ.” Támɛ oyin ámʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Owíé, ha mɩ́ anyopulá mɩ́ sɩ́ asa ambobuo fʋ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Si awupʋ́
abʋpula amʋ́ afúli. Támɛ fʋ́ mʋ́ yɔ afʋyɛda Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɔkan.”
Ɔkʋ ɛ́ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, nóbuo fʋ, támɛ ha mɩ́ anyinki yɛklá mɩ́ wóyítɔ́ ahá asa.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtɛsrɩ́ dámlí kɩ ɔma mɔ́fʋn ha Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ agyʋ́má yɔ.”

Awupʋ́ gyí ahá ánɩ́ bawú ɔŋɛ́tɔ́.
